create_logging_pool: create a thread pool that logs exceptions raised by tasks executed within it
submit_task_to_pool: submit a callable with arguments to the logging pool for concurrent execution
map_function_over_iterables: map a function over iterables using the logging pool with optional timeout
shutdown_logging_pool: shutdown the logging thread pool and optionally wait for running tasks to complete
use_pool_as_context_manager: use the logging pool as a context manager to auto-shutdown after task execution
